title: GeekMon Server
description:
GeekMon is s cobblemon server made for my community and future content
(under development)
body:
Welcome to GeekMon, a Cobblemon server inspired by the Twitch streams and community of GeekFire18. GeekMon is built for players who love Pokémon adventures, survival, exploration, and community-driven gameplay.

Train powerful Pokémon, battle other trainers, explore massive worlds, build your dream base, and become part of an active and growing community. The server focuses on balanced progression, exciting events, competitive gameplay, and creating a fun experience for both casual and dedicated players.

Whether you want to grind for rare Pokémon, build with friends, compete in battles, or simply enjoy the adventure, GeekMon offers a unique experience where every player can create their own story.

Join the community, start your journey, and become part of the world of GeekMon.
